records.mutation: reframe 'I don't know' as a divisibility/range test on the speaker's own value under an unlabelled displayed quantity, and forbid boxing an enumerated candidate without checking it
records.subagent_summary: Fresh sampling with the incumbent hint scored 2/8; five of the six failures enumerated the factor pairs of the displayed number, declared both readings contradictory, then boxed an arbitrary member of that enumeration, and one ran to the token cap. The incumbent tells the student to prune information sets but never says the displayed quantity's own label is ambiguous nor how to convert 'I don't know' into a concrete arithmetic test on the speaker's private value, so I added both and an explicit ban on boxing an unverified enumerated candidate.

records.mutation: keep incumbent ratio/locus setup, add sign-check discipline plus a non-looping recovery route (fit general circle to explicit points) and a commit-early boxing rule
records.subagent_summary: Seven of eight fresh rollouts were correct; the single failure exhausted the 16384-token cap after a sign error made one explicitly computed root disagree with its own correct symbolic locus, triggering dozens of self-doubting restarts and no committed result. Round 1 showed that stripping the concrete substitution hurt transfer, so I kept the incumbent setup and appended the transferable fix: verify the parametrization on one explicit instance, and when a spot-check conflicts, recover by fitting the general conic form to a few exact points instead of relitigating, then commit and box early.

records.mutation: add explicit anti-containment check: a vertex is only an interior-angle wedge, verify with a test point
records.subagent_summary: Four of eight rollouts solved it; every one of the four failures came from the same wrong belief that the larger square contains the smaller one in all orientations, so they concluded the overlap equals the whole small square and reported a union that was too small (two of them even asserted this confidently and stopped). The incumbent's invariance advice alone did not stop this, so the revision names the geometric trap directly: a vertex only spans its interior angle, verify non-containment with one concrete test point, and only then use the n-fold-symmetry wedge argument to get the overlap fraction without any angle sweep.

records.mutation: kill the single-function consecutive-difference contradiction loop; state the caps-product as the answer and forbid retreating to d or the function count
records.subagent_summary: All 8 fresh rollouts scored 0: four hit the 16384-token limit while relooping on a self-inflicted "contradiction" that one polynomial's consecutive difference cannot be constant, and the four that stopped answered with the function count or a single function's root cap. One rollout actually derived the correct caps-product but then talked itself back down to a single function's cap, so the revision names the product as the intended answer, bans the retreat, explicitly dissolves the consecutive-difference contradiction (consecutive terms may use different functions), and orders early abandonment of impossibility branches to cut truncation.

records.mutation: replace problem-specific procedure with general condition-translation, exact-fraction, and validity-constraint discipline
records.subagent_summary: All eight fresh rollouts solved the training question correctly at roughly 9.5k completion tokens each, so train accuracy is saturated and the only remaining lever is transfer, where the incumbent scores low because its wording is tied to one specific setup (logarithmic fractional-linear parameters, oriented vectors, determinant area). The prior round's failure mode was a rollout that mistranslated the point-pairing condition, hit an empty solution set, and then looped on recomputation until it ran out of tokens, so I kept an anti-loop and substitute-back rule but expressed the whole hint as domain-general discipline: translate conditions exactly, reduce to one unknown, keep exact fractions, enumerate validity constraints, and reject extraneous roots.

records.mutation: pin mechanics/first-vs-last arrival, then convert event to an exact move-sequence constraint counted only over free 50/50 choices
records.subagent_summary: Fresh sampling with the incumbent gave 2/8; all eight rollouts terminated normally with 11k-16k tokens, so length is not the bottleneck. The incumbent already suppressed 1/n! on part (a) (four rollouts derived 1/2^(n-1) there) but every failure then reverted to an asserted 'each item equally likely in any position' shortcut on the second part, and several also mixed up whether the target position corresponds to the first or the last arrival on the stack. The revision therefore demands the mechanics and the first-vs-last mapping be pinned before counting, that the event be restated as an exact constraint on the move sequence, that only genuinely free 50/50 branches be multiplied (forced moves contribute 1), and that each part be re-derived independently.

records.mutation: small-case-first computation with claim-testing and a no-restart stall rule
records.subagent_summary: Fresh sampling under the incumbent hint scored 0 of 8, and 7 of 8 rollouts hit the 16384-token cap without ever emitting an answer; the abstract functional/Vandermonde/Lagrange framing sent them into long symbolic derivations that repeatedly self-contradicted and restarted. The single rollout that terminated asserted an unchecked structural claim and answered from it, and the only prior success instead solved the smallest instances by hand and read off the pattern. The revision therefore front-loads exact small-case computation, demands that structural claims be tested on the smallest case, and forbids restarting a stalled derivation so the budget is spent on verifiable arithmetic.

records.mutation: keep question-anchored divisibility scaffold, prepend per-unit-vs-total scope labeling and add back-multiplication check
records.subagent_summary: All 8 fresh rollouts scored reward 1 and stopped cleanly in 2.9-4.6k tokens, so train_i is saturated and gains must come from transfer; last round's fully de-specialized checklist rewrite collapsed train to 0.25 and also lost held-out ground, so I kept the incumbent's concrete anchoring instead of abstracting it away. The dominant observable waste in the rollouts is a long stretch of re-reading to decide whether each listed figure is a per-unit amount or a whole-collection total, so I prepended that scope-labeling step and replaced the vague integrality/units clause with a concrete back-multiplication check, both reusable moves rather than problem-specific facts.

records.mutation: replace coefficient-matching guidance with a commit-to-a-structured-family-then-fit recipe, plus special-input substitution and center-check shortcuts
records.subagent_summary: All 8 fresh rollouts scored 0 and every one hit the 16384-token cap; each opened by naming eight unknown coefficients for the two cubics and then spent the whole budget expanding the degree-9 composition, looping on contradictory coefficient relations without ever finishing. The incumbent hint told the student to avoid full expansion but still pointed at term matching, so the revision forbids the unknown-coefficient opening outright and gives a concrete alternative: posit a minimal structured family that satisfies the identity automatically, fit it to the two given values, and verify once by substitution.

records.mutation: replace symbolic index-formula derivation with concrete label-row simulation, warn that stages compose on the previous result, and require exact counts at two-plus sizes
records.subagent_summary: Only 2 of 8 rollouts were correct and 5 of the 6 failures hit the 16384-token cap while still attempting a symbolic map from index to index, several explicitly abandoning small-case checks as 'too abstract' or 'too long'; the sixth finished but asserted a uniform cycle length one power too small without ever counting. The recurring mechanical error was applying each stage to the original positions instead of to the arrangement the previous stage produced, which yielded impossible cycle lengths and triggered endless re-derivation. The revision therefore swaps the incumbent's bitwise-affine-permutation framing for concrete label-row simulation, names the stage-composition slip as the cause of implausible cycle lengths, and demands exact counts at two or more sizes since the tiniest case underdetermines the pattern.
